activity_events_dedupe_needs_operation.name: activity_events_dedupe_needs_operation
activity_events_dedupe_needs_operation.value: "activity_events"."dedupe_key" is null or "activity_events"."operation_id" is not null

application_details_salary_range.name: application_details_salary_range
application_details_salary_range.value: "application_details"."salary_min" is null or "application_details"."salary_max" is null or "application_details"."salary_min" <= "application_details"."salary_max"

card_documents_title_valid.name: card_documents_title_valid
card_documents_title_valid.value: "card_documents"."deleted_at" is not null or length("card_documents"."title") between 1 and 200

card_documents_url_valid.name: card_documents_url_valid
card_documents_url_valid.value: "card_documents"."url" is null or "card_documents"."url" like 'http://%' or "card_documents"."url" like 'https://%'

card_documents_fingerprint_valid.name: card_documents_fingerprint_valid
card_documents_fingerprint_valid.value: ("card_documents"."deleted_at" is null and coalesce(length("card_documents"."request_fingerprint"), 0) = 64) or ("card_documents"."deleted_at" is not null and "card_documents"."request_fingerprint" is null)

card_documents_tombstone_scrubbed.name: card_documents_tombstone_scrubbed
card_documents_tombstone_scrubbed.value: "card_documents"."deleted_at" is null or ("card_documents"."title" = '' and "card_documents"."url" is null and "card_documents"."note" is null)

card_notes_body_valid.name: card_notes_body_valid
card_notes_body_valid.value: "card_notes"."deleted_at" is not null or length("card_notes"."body") between 1 and 10000

card_notes_fingerprint_valid.name: card_notes_fingerprint_valid
card_notes_fingerprint_valid.value: ("card_notes"."deleted_at" is null and coalesce(length("card_notes"."request_fingerprint"), 0) = 64) or ("card_notes"."deleted_at" is not null and "card_notes"."request_fingerprint" is null)

tasks_due_on_valid.name: tasks_due_on_valid
tasks_due_on_valid.value: "tasks"."due_on" is null or ("tasks"."due_on" glob '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' and date("tasks"."due_on") is "tasks"."due_on")
